info.title: Sales Force API
info.description: Sales Force HTTP API. Generated from the Zod contracts in @salesforce/contracts; do not edit by hand. Decimal values are strings. Errors use { code, message, details? }.

get.summary: Liveness
get.description: The process is up. Does not check the database or the integration.

get.summary: Readiness
get.description: Database, migration level and integration summary. A degraded integration does not make the API not ready.

post.summary: Sign in
post.description: Sets the HttpOnly session cookie. The response body carries no token.

post.summary: Sign out

put.summary: Set or replace the caller's own profile photo
put.description: Own photo only (there is no way to name another account). Body: the image base64-encoded (jpeg, png or webp, up to 5 MiB decoded) with its declared content type and an optional crop rectangle in pixels (after EXIF orientation). The server checks the magic bytes against the declared type, refuses animated or oversized (> 32 megapixels) images, crops to a centre square, downsizes to at most 512 px and re-encodes as WebP without any metadata (EXIF, location). 400 validation_failed (details.issues: photo_type_not_allowed, photo_content_mismatch, photo_too_large, photo_unreadable, photo_crop_invalid, photo_too_small); 429 rate_limited when changed again within 5 seconds; 503 service_unavailable when photo storage is not configured or unreachable. 200 returns the new version. Not mirrored to the ERP.

delete.summary: Remove the caller's own profile photo
delete.description: Idempotent: 204 whether or not a photo existed. Audited when one was removed.

get.summary: The caller's own profile photo (binary)
get.description: Authenticated only, own photo only. 404 when there is none. Always a square WebP of at most 512 px. The ETag is the photo version (the same value as photoVersion in the session); send it in If-None-Match to get 304. Cache-Control is private; nosniff.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

get.summary: Current session
get.description: Always 200: `authenticated` tells whether a valid session exists.

get.summary: Installation configuration summary and integration state
get.description: Client-safe snapshot summary, sync states, gateway mode. Never contains secrets.

get.summary: The caller's own seller discount rules (offline sync)
get.description: Only the rules of the seller linked to the caller; a manager or admin has none. Never another seller's rules.

get.summary: Discount limits per authority level (W-39, admin only)
get.description: The three inclusive limits (seller, manager, director = absolute ceiling) in force, flagged provisional until the admin confirms them.

put.summary: Replace the discount limits (W-39, admin only, audited)
put.description: Stores a new immutable configuration snapshot. Ascending (seller <= manager <= director), inclusive, 0 to 99.99. Optimistic on expectedRevision.

get.summary: Force configuration: days without sync and default price table (admin and manager)

put.summary: Replace the Force configuration (admin and manager, audited)
put.description: The default price table must exist in the ERP price-table mirror (400 otherwise).

get.summary: Per-seller discount rules, optionally of one seller (admin and manager)

post.summary: Create a per-seller discount rule (admin and manager, audited)
post.description: 409 when the same (seller, target kind, target) already has a rule; 400 for an unknown seller or an invalid target.

put.summary: Change the percent of a per-seller discount rule (admin and manager, audited)

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

get.summary: App parameters of the Force configuration (days without sync, default price table)
Validates the X-Server-Code header (204 when accepted)
get.description: Public of any session, protected by the global server-code guard: a missing or wrong code is a bodiless 401 before this handler runs.

get.summary: Minimal configuration slice for the order-entry screen
get.description: Only the fields order-editor needs (general.enabled, sales.negotiationTypes/defaultNegotiationTypeCode/orderBehavior, products.productWithoutPrice.orderable). Never the admin-only /configuration payload.

200.description: Configuração mínima do fluxo de pedido

get.summary: Dashboard KPIs within the actor scope
Monthly goal, realized and positivation within the actor scope

post.summary: Ask the worker to re-read the Sankhya data now (D-AB B3)
post.description: The API never reads Sankhya: it records the request and the worker runs the read-only steps. Singleton: a refresh already running is returned (reused=true); so is one that finished less than 60 s ago (per-installation cooldown).

get.summary: Progress of an on-demand refresh, one step per entity

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

get.summary: Age of the Sankhya data shown in the screens
Server-sent events: content-free change pings (RT-1)
get.description: text/event-stream. Frames are "event: ping" with data {"topic":"orders"} or {"topic":"reference"}; a comment heartbeat every 25 s. No business data: the client re-reads through the normal authorized endpoints. At most 5 streams per account (429 beyond that). The stream ends when the session is revoked or expires.

get.summary: List sellers visible to the actor
Customer portfolio (scoped)

post.summary: Create a customer in the Force (written to the ERP by the worker)
post.description: Records the creation and waits up to ~8 s (configurable) for the worker to deliver it to the ERP (CUST-RT). 201 with `sendState` `sent` and the real `customerCode`; 202 with `sendState` `pending` when the ERP did not answer in time (delivery continues in the worker; the client shows a pending-send indicator and follows GET /customers/registrations/{id}); 200 with the recorded state on a replay of the same `clientRequestId` and payload. 422 `customer_refused` with `details.fields` (field -> pt-BR text: `sellerCode`, `document`, `stateRegistration`, ...) when validation or the ERP refuses (missing seller, repeated CPF/CNPJ, required field): nothing is left half saved and no correction queue exists; fix the data and POST again with a NEW `clientRequestId`. Seller: automatic for a seller (own ERP code); required for manager/admin (422 on `sellerCode` without any ERP call). 409 idempotency_conflict when the id was used with a different payload; 409 `customer_write_disabled` while the installation has not enabled customer writes. The credit limit is never sent. 400 validation_failed (details.issues) for a malformed body. 429 rate_limited beyond the hourly creation limit. `correctsRegistrationId` is still accepted by old builds and ignored.

201.description: Cliente criado e confirmado no Sankhya

422.description: Cadastro de cliente recusado (customer_refused; details.fields mapeia campo -> texto)

get.summary: Count of visible customers per initial letter (A-Z index)
Customers created in the Force that are not yet in the ERP mirror, or were refused (scoped)
get.description: Each item carries `sendState` (`sent` with `customerCode`, or `pending`) and the legacy `state`/`stateLabel`. A refused customer is not listed (the refusal is answered by POST /customers as 422). Scope: the creator; a manager/admin sees those of the sellers they reach.

200.description: Cadastros de clientes feitos pelo Force

get.summary: One customer registration with its state (scoped)
get.description: A registration outside the actor scope answers 404, like a missing one. Use it to follow an `awaiting_send` customer after the 202 of POST /customers.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

put.summary: Set the seller of a pending customer that has none and send it again (manager/admin)
put.description: Manager/admin only (a seller answers 403; outside the actor scope 404). Only a customer not yet delivered (no ERP code). The seller must be an active seller of the ERP mirror (422 customer_refused on sellerCode otherwise). Re-enqueues delivery through the outbox; the API never calls the ERP. Answers the registration view.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

422.description: Cadastro de cliente recusado (customer_refused; details.fields mapeia campo -> texto)

patch.summary: Edit phone, e-mail and notes of a customer (D-AP); written to the ERP by the worker
patch.description: Same rule for the site and the app. Allow-list: any other key is refused with 400 validation_failed whose `details.issues[].path` names the field (unrecognized_keys). Seller: only customers of their own portfolio; manager/admin: the portfolio they reach; outside it 404. 409 conflict with `details.reason` `customer_edit_disabled` while `ERP_CUSTOMER_EDIT_ENABLED` is closed (default; nothing is stored and the ERP is never called). With the flag open the change is recorded as a command in the outbox and the API waits up to ~8 s (configurable) for the worker to deliver it (CUST-RT): 200 with `sendState` `sent`; 202 with `sendState` `pending` when the ERP did not answer in time (delivery continues; replay the same `clientRequestId` and payload to follow it: 200); 422 `customer_refused` with `details.fields` (field -> pt-BR text) when the ERP refuses (nothing changes locally; send a new `clientRequestId`). 409 `idempotency_conflict` for the same id with another payload; 409 `customer_update_in_progress` while another edit of the same customer is not yet delivered. `contacts` and `addresses` are accepted by the schema but refused with 409 `details.reason` `customer_edit_field_not_supported` (the ERP mapping is not validated, S5.2); phone, e-mail and notes are the deliverable fields. Never changes name, document, seller, price table, status or limits.

202.description: Alteração registrada, aguardando envio ao Sankhya

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

422.description: Cadastro de cliente recusado (customer_refused; details.fields mapeia campo -> texto)

get.summary: Customer detail (scoped)
get.description: A customer outside the actor scope is reported as 404.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

get.summary: Customer financial information (read-only, scoped)
get.description: Open titles and credit information mirrored from the ERP (D-I). A customer outside the actor scope, or an installation that does not show the financial area, is reported as 404.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

get.summary: Negotiation type most used in the customer's Sales Force orders (read-only, scoped)
get.description: Counts only orders recorded in Sales Force (sent for approval or delivery; drafts and rejected ones excluded), never Sankhya/ERP history. A customer outside the actor scope answers 404, like a missing one.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

get.summary: Product groups
Active carriers (transportadoras) mirrored from Sankhya, ordered by name
ERP cities (code, name, UF, IBGE) for the customer registration, ordered by UF and name
Active price tables with mobility (code, name) for the customer registration, ordered by name

200.description: Tabelas de preço do cadastro de cliente

get.summary: ERP neighborhoods (code, name) for the customer registration, ordered by name
ERP streets (code, name, kind) for the customer registration, ordered by name
Address of a postal code (CEP), matched against the ERP registry
get.description: Looks the CEP up in ViaCEP and, when it does not answer, BrasilAPI (about 2 s each; only the 8 digits leave the server). Never an error for a CEP that is invalid, unknown or whose sources are down: answers 200 with `found: false`. When found, `cityCode` is set when the ERP city matches (IBGE + UF, else name without accents + UF) and `neighborhoodCode` / `streetCode` when the text matches an ERP row; otherwise only the text is returned. Same authorization as customer registration.

get.summary: Company data of a CNPJ (public registry), to prefill the legal-entity registration
get.description: Server-side only: BrasilAPI and, when it does not answer, publica.cnpj.ws (about 3 s each; only the 14 digits leave the server). Answers are kept for 30 days. Never an error for a CNPJ that is invalid, unknown or whose sources are down: answers 200 with `found: false`. Same authorization as customer registration; limited per account (429 `rate_limited`).

get.summary: Product catalog with list price context
get.description: With `customerCode` prices are resolved against that customer table (within scope); otherwise against the catalog reference table.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

get.summary: Product detail with list price context

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

get.summary: Current list prices of ONE price table (for the device, one table at a time)
get.description: Only tables used by customers within the caller's scope (the customer's mobile-eligible table, or the configured fallback table when a visible customer has none); any other table, or a missing one, is the same 404 (no oracle). Only products that are mobility-visible, sellable and priced above zero in the effective version; the list price only (no cost, no margin), ordered by product code. The device keeps these per table and applies the table of the customer it is ordering for.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

get.summary: Product image (binary)
get.description: Same access as the catalog: a product the caller cannot see is 404, a seller without a seller link is 403 no_seller_scope. 404 also when the product has no image. The server serves only png, jpeg or webp content it has verified (never svg/html), with `nosniff`, `Content-Disposition: inline` and `Cache-Control: private`. `ETag` is derived from the opaque image version; send it back in `If-None-Match` to get 304. 503 when the image source is unavailable (retry later). The client never supplies a URL or path.

ETag.description: Entity tag derived from the opaque image version

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

post.summary: Resolve a batch of product identifiers
post.description: A read, not a write. Each identifier (trimmed) is matched exactly, with no wildcard or fuzzy matching: against the product code when it is all digits without leading zeros ('007' is not code 7), and against the product reference (case-sensitive). One answer per identifier, in request order; a duplicate identifier is answered at each position. found: exactly one visible product; ambiguous: several (up to 5 candidates, ordered by code); not_found: none. A product the configuration hides from the catalog counts as not found. With `customerCode` prices come from that customer table (404 outside the seller scope); otherwise from the catalog reference table. Body up to 128 kB.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

get.summary: Orders and drafts (scoped)

post.summary: Create a draft order
post.description: Idempotent on `clientRequestId`: 201 when created, 200 with the original order on a replay of the same payload, 409 idempotency_conflict when the id was used with a different payload. Prices are always computed server-side. `expectedDataset` is required: 409 dataset_mismatch (nothing is written) when it differs from the dataset the server declares, or the server declares none.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

get.summary: Order detail (scoped)

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

put.description: Full replace. 409 version_conflict when `expectedVersion` is stale; 409 order_not_editable when the order is not a draft. The server recomputes prices and totals. `expectedDataset` is required: 409 dataset_mismatch (the order is not changed) when it differs from the dataset the server declares, or the server declares none.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

delete.summary: Delete a quote or order that never reached Sankhya (D-Y)
delete.description: Physical deletion with its items and delivery records. 409 when the order has an ERP number or a delivery is queued or in progress. Recorded in the audit trail.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

get.summary: Lines of a draft whose table price changed (P-09)
get.description: Compares each line with the price of the table today. Empty `lines` = nothing to review. Same scope as the order.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

post.summary: Accept or refuse each changed price (P-09)
post.description: One decision for every line the review lists. Accept = the line takes the table price; refuse = the line leaves the order. The server prices again and validates as a normal edit. 409 version_conflict when `expectedVersion` is stale; 409 order_not_editable when the order is not a draft; 400 validation_failed when a decision is missing or the order would be left empty.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

post.summary: Edit an order already sent to Sankhya (delete and recreate the unconfirmed note)
post.description: Owner ruling 2026-11-27. Queues the edit (outbox operation edit_order) and answers 200 with the order in `queued`; the worker revalidates eligibility live (note not confirmed, invoiced, in a load, released or financially settled), deletes the old note and recreates it, keeping the previous ERP note number in the history. Idempotent per `clientRequestId`. 409 conflict (details.reason `not_editable_in_erp`) when the order is not eligible; 409 version_conflict when `expectedVersion` is stale; 409 dataset_mismatch; 409 erp_submission_disabled. The server reprices and revalidates as in a replace.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

post.summary: Convert a quote that never reached Sankhya into an order, in place (D-U a)
post.description: The TOP becomes the installation order TOP on the same record (same id, number and lines); the version is bumped and a pending approval is invalidated. 409 not_a_quotation when the document is not a quote, already_in_sankhya when it has a Sankhya number (native conversion is a separate step), order_top_not_configured without an order TOP.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

post.summary: Submit an order: sends it for discount approval, or (disabled) to the ERP
post.description: The server recomputes the discount authority from the stored lines with the role of the draft OWNER (DISC-5, Q12). Above that authority: 200 with the order in awaiting_approval (idempotent for an order already waiting). Above the director ceiling: 409 discount_blocked. Within authority: 409 erp_submission_disabled until the ERP write-safety gates close (SNK-4/SNK-5).

200.description: Pedido enviado para aprovação de desconto

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

409.description: Envio ao ERP aguardando conclusão da integração segura

post.summary: Verify now: asks the worker to check an ambiguous (unknown) delivery by origin right away
post.description: Same delivery record and origin id, no second outbox row and no second note (SNK-4). Only for an order whose delivery is `unknown`; any other state returns the order unchanged. At most one request per order every 60 s (429). The actor is audited.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

post.summary: Asks the worker to re-read this order in Sankhya now (RT-1)
post.description: Records the request only (the API never calls Sankhya); the worker serves it within seconds and the clients learn the result from the next orders ping. 202 even inside the 10 s per-order cooldown (accepted=false). 404 when the order is outside the caller scope, removed or unknown.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

get.summary: Discount approval queue (W-20): the pending requests the caller may decide
get.description: Manager role: requests of the manager level. Admin: requests of the director level ("Diretoria"). Oldest first. Online only; no push.

post.summary: Approve a pending discount request (explicit, audited)
post.description: Only the pool of the request level decides. The comment is optional. 409 approval_not_pending when the request was already decided, invalidated by an edit, or the order is no longer waiting; 409 discount_blocked when the stored lines no longer fit any level under the current limits.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

post.summary: Reject a pending discount request (explicit, audited, comment mandatory)
post.description: The order becomes approval_rejected: editable by the seller, never sent as it stands.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

get.summary: Release queue ("Aguardando liberação"): orders waiting for a Sankhya release, by sector (read only)
get.description: Orders sent to Sankhya that hold a pending release line (TSILIB) of Pedidos or Financeiro, oldest waiting first, one row per line and sector. The release is done in Sankhya; the Force never writes it. Admin and manager see every sector; a user listed in `erp.releaseQueue.sectorUsers` sees only the listed sector(s); everyone else (sellers included) is refused with 403. A `sector` filter the caller may not see is 403. Data is the worker's mirror of the Sankhya read (`checkedAt` per row); "Atualizar agora" is POST /sync/refresh. No cost or margin.

get.summary: Counter of the release queue for the menu (orders waiting, per sector the caller may see)
get.description: Same visibility as listReleaseQueue (403 when the caller sees no sector). Counts orders, not lines: an order waiting in both sectors counts once in `total`.

post.summary: Create a new draft from the customer's most recent order ('Repetir último pedido')
post.description: Creates a NEW, independent draft from the customer's most recent NON-cancelled order recorded in Sales Force (never from Sankhya/ERP history, which is not mirrored here), through the same path as `createOrder`, using `clientRequestId` as the draft request id (201 created; 200 with the original draft on a replay of the same request). Only `productCode` and `quantity` are copied from the source order; no price, discount or note. Each line is revalidated against the current catalog and the customer price context; lines whose product is removed, inactive, hidden, not sellable or without a usable price are left out and reported in `skippedLines`, never priced by guess. The new draft is assigned to the customer's CURRENT seller, which may differ from the source order's seller. 409 conflict (details.reason `no_previous_order`) when the customer has no previous order in Sales Force at all. 409 conflict (details.reason `no_usable_lines`, with `skippedLines`) when no line of the source order can be used: no draft is created. The source order is never modified. `expectedDataset` is required: 409 dataset_mismatch (nothing is written) when it differs from the dataset the server declares, or the server declares none.

201.description: Pedido não enviado criado a partir do último pedido

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

post.summary: Create a new draft order from a quotation ('Duplicar como pedido')
post.description: Creates a NEW, independent draft carrying the installation's default order TOP from an order that carries the quotation TOP and is visible to the caller, through the same path as `createOrder` (201 created; 200 with the original draft on a replay of the same `clientRequestId`). Lines (product, quantity, discount), negotiation type, notes and carrier are copied and each line is revalidated against the current catalog and prices; lines that cannot be ordered now are left out and reported in `skippedLines`, never priced by guess. The source quotation is never modified and no new state exists: the result is an ordinary draft whose `sourceOrderId` points to the quotation. 404 when the source is not visible. 409 conflict (details.reason `not_a_quotation`) when the source does not carry the quotation TOP; `order_top_not_configured` when the installation has no default order TOP; `no_usable_lines` (with `skippedLines`) when no line can be used. `expectedDataset` is required: 409 dataset_mismatch (nothing is written) when it differs from the dataset the server declares.

201.description: Pedido não enviado criado a partir do orçamento

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

get.summary: Recurring order templates of a customer (scoped)
get.description: Live templates of the customer, by name. A customer outside the actor scope is reported as 404. At most 50 per customer.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

post.summary: Save a recurring order template for a customer
post.description: A saved list of product + quantity (1 to 500 lines, each product once); no price, discount or note. Idempotent on `clientRequestId` per account: 201 when created, 200 with the same template on a replay of the same payload, 409 idempotency_conflict when the id was used with a different payload. 409 conflict (details.reason `template_limit_reached`) beyond 50 live templates for the customer; 409 conflict (`template_name_taken`) when a live template of the customer already has that name, ignoring case. `expectedDataset` is required: 409 dataset_mismatch (nothing is written) when it differs from the dataset the server declares, or the server declares none. Body up to 128 kB.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

get.summary: Order template detail (scoped)
get.description: A template of a customer outside the actor scope, or a deleted one, is reported as 404.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

put.description: Full replace of name and lines; the customer never changes. 409 version_conflict when `expectedVersion` is stale; 409 conflict (`template_name_taken`) on a name collision. `expectedDataset` is required: 409 dataset_mismatch (the template is not changed) when it differs from the dataset the server declares, or the server declares none. Body up to 128 kB.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

delete.description: Orders already created from the template are not affected.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

post.summary: Create a new draft order from a template
post.description: Creates a NEW draft for the template customer through the same path as `createOrder`, using `clientRequestId` as the draft request id (201 created; 200 with the original draft on a replay of the same request). Each line is revalidated against the current catalog and the customer price context; lines whose product is removed, inactive, hidden, not sellable or without a usable price are left out and reported in `skippedLines`, never priced by guess. 409 conflict (details.reason `no_usable_lines`, with `skippedLines`) when no line can be used: no draft is created. The draft is independent of the template afterwards. `expectedDataset` is required: 409 dataset_mismatch (nothing is written) when it differs from the dataset the server declares, or the server declares none.

201.description: Pedido não enviado criado a partir do modelo

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

get.summary: Tasks of the caller (manager and admin: every task)
get.description: A seller sees only the tasks assigned to them; manager and admin see all tasks. Ordered by due date. The linked customer name is returned only when the customer is inside the caller scope.

post.summary: Create a task (idempotent on id)
post.description: The task id is generated by the client and is the idempotency key: 201 when created, 200 with the same task on a replay of the same payload, 409 idempotency_conflict when the id was used with another payload. The assignee is the caller. A customer outside the caller scope is 404.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

post.summary: Complete a task (idempotent)
post.description: Completing a completed task answers the same task. 409 conflict when the task was cancelled. A task of another seller is 404 for a seller.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

post.summary: Cancel a task (idempotent)
post.description: 409 conflict when the task was already completed.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

get.summary: Notifications of the caller, newest first
get.description: Only the caller own notifications, with the unread count.

post.summary: Mark notifications as read
post.description: Omitted `ids` marks every notification of the caller. Ids of other accounts are ignored.

put.summary: Register the Expo push token of the device for the caller
put.description: Idempotent. A token already registered moves to the caller account. Mobile only.

post.summary: Stop push notifications on this device
post.description: Idempotent: 204 whether or not the token was registered for the caller.

get.summary: Spreadsheet template (.xlsx) to send to a customer: sellable products and a Quantidade column (binary)
get.description: One sheet with the sellable products of the catalog (code, description, unit, reference) and an empty Quantidade column. Never a price, cost or margin. Same profiles as order entry.

post.summary: Read a spreadsheet and show what an import would do (writes nothing)
post.description: Body: the .xlsx or .csv file base64-encoded (up to 20 MiB decoded, 50,000 rows). Type, size, signature and row count are checked BEFORE the file is parsed: 400 validation_failed with issue import_file_type_not_allowed, import_file_too_large, import_file_unreadable, import_too_many_rows or import_empty. Formulas are never evaluated (the cached cell value is read) and macros never run. Without a mapping the server suggests one by header name. order_items needs customerCode (404 outside the seller scope). Unrecognised rows are listed with the reason and never block the rest. The file content is never logged.

404.description: Recurso não encontrado (ou fora do escopo do usuário)

post.summary: Run an import: a quotation from the recognised lines, or customers through the registration path
post.description: order_items creates ONE quotation (quotation TOP) with the recognised lines, prices computed server-side (409 dataset_mismatch like POST /orders; 409 import_nothing_to_import when no row is recognised). customers records each valid row through the same path as POST /customers (document, CPF/CNPJ validity, duplicate, CEP, seller scope, hourly budget), at most 30 rows per confirm; rejected rows come back with the reason. get.summary: Customers (scoped) as CSV or XLSX (internal profiles only)
get.description: Internal profiles with the export grant only; the external representative has no grant (403). Rows follow the same scope as GET /customers. Up to 50,000 rows. Audited on every call (who, what, how many rows, format; never the content).

get.summary: Orders and quotations (scoped) as CSV or XLSX (internal profiles only)
get.description: Same grant and audit as the customer export; rows follow the scope of GET /orders. Totals are estimates from list prices; never cost or margin.

get.summary: Catalog products as CSV or XLSX (internal profiles only)
get.description: Same grant and audit as the customer export. Code, description, unit, group, reference and status only: never price, cost or margin.
